independent_review: Separate shared-context read-only reviewer reaggregated RESULTS.npz; summary matched. Not a blind review.

fallacy_scan.name: Simpson paradox
fallacy_scan.assessment: Checked all 24 strata; all paired scene-mean NLL directions improve, while adverse axis metrics are retained.

fallacy_scan.name: Ecological fallacy
fallacy_scan.assessment: Scene means are not guarantees for every user. Per-user data remain available.

fallacy_scan.name: Berkson selection
fallacy_scan.assessment: Twelve uniform and twelve failure-enriched scenes reported separately; enriched set is not population-representative.

fallacy_scan.name: Collider bias
fallacy_scan.assessment: Main comparison is not conditioned on final miss; activity split reflects the modeled target and all users are retained.

fallacy_scan.name: Base rate neglect
fallacy_scan.assessment: Active and inactive strata both reported; no detection, PPV or prevalence inference.

fallacy_scan.name: Regression to mean
fallacy_scan.assessment: Paired same-error comparison; no before-after remeasurement benefit claim.

fallacy_scan.name: Survivorship
fallacy_scan.assessment: All 48 conditions, 5760 user-stage records and both folds retained; no finite-result filtering.

fallacy_scan.name: Look elsewhere
fallacy_scan.assessment: All group/SNR/stage/activity strata and all methods retained; no significance tests.

fallacy_scan.name: Forking paths
fallacy_scan.assessment: Saved PLAN before computation; this remains exploratory reuse of previously examined queries. No post-result tuning of training family.

fallacy_scan.name: Correlation versus causation
fallacy_scan.assessment: Descriptive covariance score only, not causal detection/NMSE improvement.

fallacy_scan.name: Reverse causality
fallacy_scan.assessment: No causal direction between structured errors and missed activity inferred.

decision: Retain current rank4 alpha<=0.5 separable covariance for a preliminary denoising pilot; no exact whiteness requirement or extra parameter search.
limits: Oracle fitting from true errors, not a public covariance estimator.
Output rows share structure; internal held-row scoring is not an independent-scene holdout.
Some antenna offdiagonal fractions worsen; no all-axis improvement claim.
Neither noise-distribution matching nor trained denoising/activity performance is established.
